13	//!    cache satisfies the request, using

15	//!    and `If-Modified-Since` off the mirror's header line.

23	//! mirror directory ([`ABBREVIATED_META_DIR`] vs. [`FULL_META_DIR`]),

25	//! `Accept` header on the registry request. When `published_by` is
